title: ByteDance Sets Up Dedicated AI Safety Unit to Manage Model Risks
source_used: Caixin Global (two paragraphs readable); TechNode (full text) for the detail
key_facts: ByteDance Ltd. is setting up a dedicated safety department within its core AI model division to manage and mitigate risks of the technology (Caixin).
The unit is named Seed Model - Alignment & Preparedness and will be led by Yan Lin, who previously oversaw alignment for ByteDance's Doubao AI model, the company told Caixin.
Yan will report directly to Wu Yonghui, head of ByteDance's AI model division, Seed.
TechNode, citing an internal email reported by The Paper on 13 Oct 2026, says members of the existing Responsible AI team and some of the Chat team will transfer to the new department.
Per TechNode, the unit will develop model-behaviour specifications, safety evaluations, alignment training, protective systems and risk monitoring.
Its remit includes keeping AI agents within human intentions and authorised limits and addressing chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear risks.
Seed also plans to expand cooperation with external researchers and independent evaluators (TechNode, citing The Paper).
quote_evidence: ByteDance Ltd. is setting up a dedicated safety department within its core AI model division to manage and mitigate risks associated with the technology.
The new unit, named Seed Model - Alignment & Preparedness, will be led by Yan Lin, who previously oversaw alignment for the company’s Doubao AI model, the company told Caixin.
Yan Lin will lead the unit and report to Seed head Wu Yonghui.
why_it_matters_hint: The owner of TikTok is giving AI safety and alignment work its own department with a named leader inside its main AI lab.
notes: Caixin's page was readable only for its first two paragraphs; TechNode's relay of The Paper's report (first reported 13 Oct 2026) supplies the remit. No budget, headcount or timeline given.
